component.name: Keychron Launcher
component.summary: Native Linux desktop application for Keychron keyboards and mice

description.p: KcLauncher is a native Linux desktop application port of the Keychron Launcher web application. It enables comprehensive configuration of Keychron and Lemokey keyboards and mice—including key remapping, RGB backlighting, rotary encoders, macros, and firmware updates via WebHID—without opening a web browser.

ul.li: Automated WebHID hardware pairing for Keychron keyboards, mice, and 4K receivers
Automatic Linux udev permissions configuration for zero-friction USB access
WebUSB support for STM32 and RP2040 bootloader firmware flashing
System tray integration and window state preservation
Resilient offline fallback and auto-reconnection diagnostics

description.p: Add status indicator icon to tray menu and fix background lifecycle behavior.
Initial release of KcLauncher for Linux with WebHID support and automated udev configuration.
